summary: Short, very steep kerb beside flats, with cars parked nose-in.
reasons: Apartments 11 m away at the start
Only 26 m long, shared with parked cars

best_section.where: Lower end of the north kerb, beside the flats' car bays

drivers.seclusion: Flats on the north side at 11 m near the start; the next dwellings are 22 m or more away. Shaded and enclosed.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb; little spare room on a short stretch.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, with parallel and angle bays, but a No Parking Any Time sign is on the kerb.

flags: No Parking Any Time sign on this kerb
sun_shade: Shaded by the flats and street trees, mostly from the north.
